title: Dimension between two walls in the floor plan of their level
task: Annotate the distance between two parallel walls: find the ViewPlan whose GenLevel is the walls' level, take wall face references from HostObjectUtils.GetSideFaces, build a ReferenceArray and call Document.Create.NewDimension with a dimension line; the script creates the two scratch walls it dimensions. The value is face to face, not the location-line spacing.

pitfalls.symptom: NewDimension throws an ArgumentNullException or NullReferenceException deep inside Revit.
pitfalls.cause: The view passed is null: filtering plans by GenLevel found nothing because the level was created by script and has no plan view.
pitfalls.fix: Create a plan for the level with ViewPlan.Create (levels-grids-and-plan-views), or use an existing non-template ViewPlan; NewDimension does not require the view to look at the walls' level.

pitfalls.symptom: The dimension reads up to a wall thickness more or less than the location-line spacing.
pitfalls.cause: Dimension.Value measures between the referenced FACES; Interior/Exterior is relative to each wall's own direction, so the pairing decides the reading.
pitfalls.fix: Choose the faces deliberately (same ShellLayerType on walls drawn in the same direction for a near-centreline reading) and check the value against a band, adjusting by Wall.Width; never assert an exact literal.

pitfalls.cause: Value is only set for single-segment dimensions; a multi-reference dimension exposes Segments.
pitfalls.fix: Read dim.Segments for three or more references.
